description: This file contains the jQuery Easing plugin source code, defining various easing functions for animations, and extends jQuery with these easing options.

methods.name: swing
methods.description: Default easing method that delegates to the current default easing function.

methods.name: easeInQuad
methods.description: Easing function for accelerating from zero velocity.

methods.name: easeOutQuad
methods.description: Easing function for decelerating to zero velocity.

methods.name: easeInOutQuad
methods.description: Easing function for acceleration until halfway, then deceleration.

methods.name: easeInCubic
methods.description: Easing function for accelerating from zero velocity with cubic curve.

methods.name: easeOutCubic
methods.description: Easing function for decelerating to zero velocity with cubic curve.

methods.name: easeInOutCubic
methods.description: Easing function for acceleration until halfway, then deceleration with cubic curve.

methods.name: easeInQuart
methods.description: Easing function for accelerating from zero with quartic curve.

methods.name: easeOutQuart
methods.description: Easing function for deceleration with quartic curve.

methods.name: easeInOutQuart
methods.description: Easing function for acceleration until halfway, then deceleration with quartic curve.

methods.name: easeInQuint
methods.description: Easing function for accelerating from zero with quintic curve.

methods.name: easeOutQuint
methods.description: Easing function for deceleration with quintic curve.

methods.name: easeInOutQuint
methods.description: Easing function for acceleration until halfway, then deceleration with quintic curve.

methods.name: easeInSine
methods.description: Easing function based on sine wave for smooth acceleration.

methods.name: easeOutSine
methods.description: Easing function based on sine wave for smooth deceleration.

methods.name: easeInOutSine
methods.description: Easing function combining ease-in and ease-out sine functions.

methods.name: easeInExpo
methods.description: Exponential easing for accelerating from zero.

methods.name: easeOutExpo
methods.description: Exponential easing for decelerating to zero.

methods.name: easeInCirc
methods.description: Circular easing for accelerating from zero.

methods.name: easeOutCirc
methods.description: Circular easing for decelerating to zero.

methods.name: easeInElastic
methods.description: Elastic easing with overshoot for accelerating.

methods.name: easeOutElastic
methods.description: Elastic easing with overshoot for decelerating.

methods.name: easeInBack
methods.description: Back easing with overshoot for accelerating.

methods.name: easeOutBack
methods.description: Back easing with overshoot for decelerating.
